source: Building and site rules v0.10, with the 2026-11-11 stair intersection correction

stairs.note: Open treads and the lower lip of the next tread retain collisions. The 20 mm construction overlap is intentional.

entry_ramp.note: The entrance plinth extends along the full edge to form a rectangular floor. Identical mirrored ramps cross the curb. The example rises 150 mm over 900 mm on each side and is 1200 mm wide, for a 1:6 modeled slope.

scope: Record standard construction, site imperfections and envelope estimates separately. Small grating perforations are visual. Panel joints, depressions and steps have collision geometry.

pipe_penetrations.note: Cut only the openings for small pipes. Keep panel supports and beams at equipment openings.

rails.source: Field observation: platform rails and stair handrails are often yellow. Color is approximate.

frame.source: 2026-11-10 framing sketch, with approximate geometry dimensions

human_scale.source: Optional 1.75 m person including helmet is a visual scale reference only
